description: This file defines a Flutter widget 'GeneralTab' which functions as a screen or tab displaying news articles, including top headlines in a carousel and a list of general news articles, with support for loading states and navigation to detailed articles.

classes.name: GeneralTab
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays top headlines in a carousel and a list of general news articles, handling loading states and navigation.

classes.name: _GeneralShimmer
classes.description: A widget that shows shimmering placeholders to indicate loading content in the 'GeneralTab'.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the 'GeneralTab', displaying loading states, top headlines carousel, news list, and no news message.

methods.name: _open
methods.description: Navigates to the read article screen with the selected article as an argument.
